payload.entry:
Corrected athena readout after host-evidence handoff classification (checkout implementing plan:202610/e3_live_verification_defects.md). Host: athena. Generated 2026-10-15T10:50Z.

Muse miss rates (non-research):
- Pre-cutover 2026-09-10T00:00:00Z..2026-10-05T00:00:00Z, mode none: ≤45/1438 (3%)
- Mid 2026-10-06T00:00:00Z..2026-10-14T10:35:06Z, mode legacy: ≤17/571 (3%)
- Post-cutover since 2026-10-14T10:35:00Z: no explicit Muse runs (quota until 2026-10-19)

The sase-1ko baseline attachments (notes #5, #6, #12, #13) predate this fix and overcount misses for providers whose final handoff call is not recorded in tool_calls.jsonl. Remaining legacy/none misses are runs with no lifecycle `handoff` phase and no recorded handoff tool-call text. Three JSON files of the corrected windows are attached to sase-1kt. Flag state unchanged.
